description: This file implements a DNS resolver for gRPC in Go, handling DNS lookups, SRV records, TXT records for service configs, and managing resolution intervals and errors.

classes.name: deadResolver
classes.description: A resolver that performs no operations, used as a placeholder.

classes.name: dnsResolver
classes.description: Watches DNS for a non-IP target, handling SRV, TXT, and A record lookups.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Creates and starts a DNS resolver for a target.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the DNS resolver and waits for cleanup.

methods.name: watcher
methods.description: Background goroutine that performs periodic DNS lookups and updates state.

methods.name: lookupSRV
methods.description: Performs SRV record lookup for gRPC load balancing.

methods.name: handleDNSError
methods.description: Handles DNS errors, logging and determining if errors should be ignored.

methods.name: lookupTXT
methods.description: Retrieves and parses TXT records for service configuration.

methods.name: lookupHost
methods.description: Performs A record lookup for the host.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs combined DNS resolution, including SRV and A records, and updates resolver state.

methods.name: formatIP
methods.description: Formats IP addresses, enclosing IPv6 in brackets.

methods.name: parseTarget
methods.description: Parses target string into host and port, applying defaults and handling IPv6 notation.

methods.name: canaryingSC
methods.description: Selects a service config based on JSON rules, client hostname, and percentage.
